lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukh saagar a(n)mrit har naau ||
lines.translation: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord is the ocean of peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੰਗਤ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਪਸਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ma(n)gat jan jaachai har dehu pasaau ||
lines.translation: The beggar begs for it; O Lord, please bless him, in Your kindness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har sat sat sadaa har sat har sat merai man bhaavai jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: True, True is the Lord; the Lord is forever True; the True Lord is pleasing to my mind. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਵੇ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਸ੍ਰਵਹਿ ਅਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: nave chhidr sravahi apavitraa ||
lines.translation: The nine holes pour out filth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੋਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bol har naam pavitr sabh kitaa ||
lines.translation: Chanting the Lord's Name, they are all purified and sanctified.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮਲੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: je har suprasa(n)n hovai meraa suaamee har simarat mal lahi jaavai jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: When my Lord and Master is totally pleased, He leads the mortal to meditate in remembrance on the Lord, and then his filth is taken away. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa mohu bikham hai bhaaree ||
lines.translation: Attachment to Maya is terribly treacherous.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਤਰੀਐ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiu tareeai dutar sa(n)saaree ||
lines.translation: How can one cross over the difficult world-ocean?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: satigur bohith dei prabh saachaa jap har har paar la(n)ghaavai jeeu ||4||
lines.translation: The True Lord bestows the boat of the True Guru; meditating on the Lord, Har, Har, one is carried across. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: too sarabatr teraa sabh koee ||
lines.translation: You are everywhere; all are Yours.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo too karahi soee prabh hoee ||
lines.translation: Whatever You do, God, that alone comes to pass.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਬੇਚਾਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਵੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥੧॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak gun gaavai bechaaraa har bhaavai har thaai paavai jeeu ||5||1||7||
lines.translation: Poor servant Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord; as it pleases the Lord, He bestows His approval. ||5||1||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam japahu man mere ||
lines.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kilavikh kaatai har tere ||
lines.translation: The Lord shall eradicate all your sins.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਖਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har dhan raakhahu har dhan sa(n)chahu har chaladiaa naal sakhaaee jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: Treasure the Lord's wealth, and gather in the Lord's wealth; when you depart in the end, the Lord shall go along with you as your only friend and companion. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no kripaa kare so dhiaavai ||
lines.translation: He alone meditates on the Lord, unto whom He grants His Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪੈ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: nit har jap jaapai jap har sukh paavai ||
lines.translation: He continually chants the Lord's Chant; meditating on the Lord, one finds peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਆਵੈ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee har ras aavai jap har har paar la(n)ghaaee jeeu ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, the sublime essence of the Lord is obtained. Meditating on the Lord, Har, Har, one is carried across. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: nirabhau nira(n)kaar sat naam ||
lines.translation: The fearless, formless Lord - the Name is Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਸ੍ਰੇਸਟੁ ਊਤਮ ਕਾਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jag mahi sresat ootam kaam ||
lines.translation: To chant it is the most sublime and exalted activity in this world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਸਮਨ ਦੂਤ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਠੇਹ ਮਾਰਉ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: dusaman doot jamakaal theh maarau har sevak neR na jaaee jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: Doing so, the Messenger of Death, the evil enemy, is killed. Death does not even approach the Lord's servant. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਉਪਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis upar har kaa man maaniaa ||
lines.translation: One whose mind is satisfied with the Lord

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: so sevak chahu jug chahu ku(n)t jaaniaa ||
lines.translation: that servant is known throughout the four ages, in all four directions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਉਸ ਕਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਕਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਪੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਮਕੰਕਰੁ ਖਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: je us kaa buraa kahai koee paapee tis jamaka(n)kar khaaee jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: If some sinner speaks evil of him, the Messenger of Death chews him up. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh mahi ek nira(n)jan karataa ||
lines.translation: The One Pure Creator Lord is in all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਅਪਣੇ ਚਲਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kar kar vekhai apane chalataa ||
lines.translation: He stages all His wondrous plays, and watches them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਮਾਰੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jis har raakhai tis kaun maarai jis karataa aap chhadaaee jeeu ||4||
lines.translation: Who can kill that person, whom the Lord has saved? The Creator Lord Himself delivers him. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਈ ਕਰਤਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau anadin naam laee karataare ||
lines.translation: I chant the Name of the Creator Lord, night and day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਭਗਤ ਸਭੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin sevak bhagat sabhe nisataare ||
lines.translation: He saves all His servants and devotees.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਅਠ ਚਾਰਿ ਵੇਦ ਸਭਿ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਛਡਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥੨॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: das ath chaar ved sabh poochhahu jan naanak naam chhadaaee jeeu ||5||2||8||
lines.translation: Consult the eighteen Puraanas and the four Vedas; O servant Nanak, only the Naam, the Name of the Lord, will deliver you. ||5||2||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 5 ghar 2 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Fifth Mehl, Second House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਡਰਪੈ ਧਰਤਿ ਅਕਾਸੁ ਨਖੵਤ੍ਰਾ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਅਮਰੁ ਕਰਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: darapai dharat akaas nakhytraa sir oopar amar karaaraa ||
lines.translation: The earth, the Akaashic ethers and the stars abide in the Fear of God. The almighty Order of the Lord is over the heads of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਡਰਪੈ ਡਰਪੈ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੁ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: paun paanee baisa(n)tar darapai darapai i(n)dr bichaaraa ||1||
lines.translation: Wind, water and fire abide in the Fear of God; poor Indra abides in the Fear of God as well. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕਾ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ekaa nirabhau baat sunee ||
lines.translation: I have heard one thing, that the One Lord alone is fearless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਸੋ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: so sukheeaa so sadaa suhelaa jo gur mil gaai gunee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He alone is at peace, and he alone is embellished forever, who meets with the Guru, and sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਹਧਾਰ ਅਰੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਡਰਪਹਿ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਡਰਿ ਮੁਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dehadhaar ar devaa darapahi sidh saadhik dar muiaa ||
lines.translation: The embodied and the divine beings abide in the Fear of God. The Siddhas and seekers die in the Fear of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਜੋਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh mar mar janame phir phir jonee joiaa ||2||
lines.translation: The 8.4 millions species of beings die, and die again, and are born over and over again. They are consigned to reincarnation. ||2||
